Q: Files missing with npm pack A:

Seems that I misinterpretated the problem: if the files were not in the tgz, it is because I add a .gitignore in /demo, ignoring js and css files. As I really don't want this files to be commited, the solution was to add a .npmignore file, with no rule matching css/js.

Q: Getting EOF exception over https call A:

I had this exact SSL/EOF issue because the Docusign SDK couldn't access the API URL of the service. The underlying reason was a Firewall restriction. We added a Firewall exception and it started working.

Q: Creating macros with parameters outside of parenthesis A:

As far as the base C Pre-Processor goes, this is impossible. The CPP cannot read information outside of the base macro expansion (so the MACRO or MACRO(arg1, ...) statements). I'm assuming Unreal used a custom pre-processor before compilation that can parse those statements.

As for your options, the best you could do is to use a standart macro with arguments. You could also write a custom pre-processor, like Unreal, but other than that, you're stuck with the basic macros.

Q: As a beginner in web development, what is a good package manager other than NPM? A:

Depending on how you define "a good professional", my recommendation would be to become familiar with all of them. Or at least any you expect that you may use in the future.

A professional does not choose a single tool and apply it to every situation. (Look up the term "golden hammer".) The more tools you understand when and how to use, the more effective you can be.

Don't arbitrarily limit yourself.

Q: Swift 4: How to compare doubles to another? A:

Its actually rather very simple:

let maxDouble = max(max(double1, double2), double3) // prints 10
